gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: Exact frozen ZIP hashes passed archive checks and all 24 episodes had zero invalid actions; local import, reset, act, and memory limits passed.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: Candidate launch activated 120 times, raising mean first-10-percent gas to 0.175 versus selected control 0.086 and shortening median first-10-percent arrival to 2.96 s versus 3.92 s. The same exact candidate ZIP showed preview steering activation in prior confirmation.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: Candidate finished 11/12 fresh matched cells versus selected full-road-guard 12/12. Candidate-only track 3 seed 7040 retired off_track at progress 0.916 with two collisions, despite 1.11 s lower median among finished laps. Completion-first rejects replacement.
